name: The Arson Betrayal
source:
The Arson Betrayal puts you in the shoes of Leo Somerfort (or any name you want). With only an apartment in Ablesmith City and enough cash to pay the bills for a few months, you've been working at a café, hoping to save enough money to be able to go to college. But one fateful encounter plunges you into the middle of a conspiracy filled with lies, betrayal, and violence.

"A time will come where a person, enlightened by the truth, will be tested; what they stand for, challenged."

"Lies, betrayal, and corruption, just one step behind, are all waiting for the right moment to strike."

"A time will come where we are defined by what we fight for..."

"Now is that time."

"Watch your back. Trust no one."

"Now it begins."

A harem visual novel, focusing on an action-thriller plot about the MC (with a name of your choosing) and his sudden involvement in a conspiracy that turns his world upside down. Players may choose to focus on one love interest, all of them, or none at all (but where's the fun in that?)

[From [url=https://crispy-chicken-prod.itch.io/the-arson-betrayal]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
纵火背叛让你扮演利奥·萨默福特（或任何你想要的名字）的角色。你在艾布尔史密斯市只有一套公寓，并且只有足够的现金来支付几个月的账单，你一直在一家咖啡馆工作，希望攒够钱来上大学。但一次致命的遭遇让你陷入了一场充满谎言、背叛和暴力的阴谋之中。

“总有一天，一个受到真理启发的人将受到考验；他们所代表的东西将受到挑战。”

“谎言、背叛、腐败，只差一步，都在等待合适的时机出击。”

“总有一天，我们将由我们为之奋斗的目标来定义……”

“现在就是那个时候了。”

“小心你的背后。不要相信任何人。”

“现在开始了。”

一部后宫视觉小说，重点讲述了关于MC（名字由你选择）以及他突然卷入一场颠覆他的世界的阴谋的动作惊悚情节。玩家可以选择专注于一个爱好、全部爱好，或者根本不关注（但这有什么乐趣呢？）

[来自[url=https://crispy-chicken-prod.itch.io/the-arson-betrayal]Itch.io[/url]]
